mentions.name: Airbolt
mentions.description: This open-source LLM proxy lets frontend apps call OpenAI or Anthropic directly without writing any backend code, keeping API keys out of client code. It ships with a small TypeScript/Node.js SDK and manages secrets, JWT auth with short-lived auto-refreshing tokens, rate limiting, and logs. It is adding bring-your-own-auth support for Auth0, Clerk, Firebase, and Supabase to further lock down APIs.
mentions.problem: Adding LLM features to apps typically required writing mini backends just to keep API keys out of client code; even with Vercel's AI SDK, a backend was still needed to securely handle API calls.
mentions.audience: Developers building apps who want LLM features without maintaining backend infrastructure
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on an open source LLM proxy that handles the boring stuff. Small SDK, call OpenAI or Anthropic from your frontend, proxy manages secrets/auth/limits/logs.
